transcript.content: Hello, welcome. What brings you in to see me today?

Um... hi. I guess I'm here because... I've been having some trouble with my work lately. Like, applications and research notes. I just keep turning them in with... small mistakes. Um, like a mislabeled artwork date, or I'll just skip a question by accident. 

It's... well, it's embarrassing. Because I honestly thought I had checked everything before handing it in. So... yeah. That's what finally made me come in.
Did you experience similar problems with attention or making careless mistakes when you were a child in school?

Yeah... I guess so. Um... even back in elementary school, my teachers would write that I had good ideas, but... I'd forget to turn in my worksheets. Or I'd just lose the instructions. 

I missed little details a lot back then, too. My parents basically had to check my backpack every night just to make sure I had everything. So... yeah. It's not really a new thing.
Have you been feeling down, depressed, or losing interest in things you normally enjoy?

Um... no. Not really. I mean... I don't think so. I still do the things I usually do. I'm just... frustrated with making those mistakes, I guess. But... no, I wouldn't say I feel depressed or anything.
Do you find yourself constantly worrying about a lot of different everyday things, to the point where it feels hard to control?
Um... no. Not really. I mean, I worry about normal things sometimes, I guess. But... no, nothing that feels out of control.
